description: Defines the ue_capability_manager class and related functions for handling UE capabilities in a 5G DU context, including decoding and updating UE resource configurations based on capability containers.

classes.name: ue_capability_manager
classes.description: Manages UE capability containers, decoding, updating UE resource configurations, and releasing resources.

methods.name: ue_capability_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with cell configurations, resource manager, logger, and test mode.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Sets default UE resource values based on capabilities upon UE creation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates UE resources based on received capability list container or summary.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources for a UE upon removal.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns an optional summary of UE capabilities.
